equation_or_program.expression: Exact comparator attempt_004: enumerate signed spanning trees on5 vertices; fix u_0=0, assign u_j-u_i=+/-d_ij along each tree, retain every distinct potential satisfying |u_i-u_j|<=d_ij for all pairs. The retained potential count equals the polar-vertex/facet count. All distances are exact integers after rational common scaling. The selected Qhull numerical reference is separate and rounds facet equations to9decimals.
